summary: Yellowfin tuna is a migratory ocean predator with bright yellow fins and a streamlined body. It travels through tropical and subtropical seas, sometimes schooling with other tunas. Malaysian fisheries authorities list it among oceanic tuna caught by the country’s vessels.

features: Streamlined body with a dark metallic-blue back
Bright yellow dorsal and anal fins and finlets
Long yellow fins in larger fish and a yellow band along the side

habitat.description: Highly migratory fish using near-surface oceanic water.

eating: Firm, relatively lean flesh has a mild, meaty flavour; the red raw flesh becomes brownish when cooked.
